name: Shared Light: Lynn Goldsmith at Selby Gardens
venue: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens, Downtown Sarasota Campus
hours_label: Daily 10 AM - 5 PM · $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, under 4 free
blurb: Final days of Selby Gardens' indoor and outdoor exhibition of Lynn Goldsmith, the celebrated rock-and-roll and nature photographer whose portraits of Patti Smith, Bruce Springsteen and others hang in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. Admission includes the bayfront gardens, conservatory and Michael's on the Bay. $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, members free.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Selby.org

name: Sarasota Bradenton Fall Home Show
venue: Robarts Arena at the Sarasota Fairgrounds
hours_label: Fri & Sat 10 AM - 7 PM, Sun 10 AM - 5 PM · Free with online pass ($10 at door), free parking
blurb: Hundreds of remodeling, landscaping, hurricane-protection and design pros under one roof: a useful stop if you just bought, are prepping to sell, or want quotes on windows, kitchens and outdoor living. Register online for a free pass; $10 at the door. Free parking at the Fairgrounds.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Sarasota's signature Saturday ritual since 1979: 70-plus vendors along Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, fresh seafood, baked goods, plants and live music. Free to browse; bring a tote and arrive early before the heat. Dog friendly.

name: As You Like It (The Sarasota Players, 97th Season Opener)
venue: The Sarasota Players at The Crossings at Siesta Key
address: 3501 S Tamiami Trail, Suite 1130, Sarasota, FL 34239
dates_label: Opens Thu, Sep 17 · runs through Sep 27
hours_label: Evenings 7:30 PM, matinees 2 PM · Tickets via box office
blurb: The Sarasota Players, the area's oldest theatre company, opens its 97th season with Shakespeare's pastoral comedy of disguise and romance in the Forest of Arden. Performances at the company's home in The Crossings at Siesta Key; park and enter by Connors Steak & Seafood. Tickets through the box office (941-365-2494).
